# Chicagoland Industrial — public guides by Pavlo Rospopa

> Educational guides to Chicagoland industrial real estate—building types, due diligence, nine-county research, property taxes, submarkets, selling, leasing, investment analysis, and an investor Q&A—plus Chicago commercial property research and a glossary.

These pages are not listings, market forecasts, legal or tax advice, or evidence of professional credentials. Verify property-specific information with the relevant authorities and qualified advisers. The secure workspace is private and is not part of this library.

## Public guides

- [Home: Chicagoland industrial investment sales](https://rospopa.com/): Pavlo Rospopa specializes in investment sales of industrial assets from 10,000 to 100,000 square feet across the nine Illinois counties below; the page also indexes the research guides and a daily list of Chicago industrial news headlines. Professional profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prospopa) and [Marcus & Millichap advisor page](https://www.marcusmillichap.com/advisors/pavlo-rospopa).
- [All guides](https://rospopa.com/resources/): Directory of every guide below.
- [Industrial real estate FAQ: 100 common questions](https://rospopa.com/resources/industrial-real-estate-faq/): Direct, answer-first responses to the 100 most common questions about industrial real estate and the Chicago industrial market—what industrial real estate is, warehouse vs. distribution center, flex, small-bay, IOS, cold storage, clear height, dock doors, truck courts, ESFR, power, NNN/gross leases, CAM, lease length, escalations, TI, lease vs. buy, cap rates, NOI, valuation, DSCR/LTV, 1031 exchanges, sale-leasebacks, selling timelines and documents, Phase I/II ESAs, ALTA surveys, estoppels, Illinois NFR letters, zoning (Chicago PMDs), Illinois property taxes, Cook County Class 6b, tax appeals, transfer taxes, and Chicagoland logistics corridors, intermodal, submarkets, and counties.
- [Industrial investor Q&A](https://rospopa.com/resources/industrial-investor-faq/): The questions experienced industrial buyers ask about pricing (cap rate vs. IRR, replacement cost, mark-to-market, exit cap), building functionality, tenants and leases, diligence, Illinois taxes and incentives, debt, and exit—answered as general education.
- [Community Q&A forum](https://rospopa.com/resources/community/): Thirty forum-style roundtable threads in which owners, investors, tenants, lenders, property managers, and tax consultants (illustrative roles, clearly labeled) raise practical Chicagoland industrial questions and Pavlo Rospopa posts the accepted answer, plus a live board of real questions from the GitHub Discussions community.
- [Industrial building types and specifications](https://rospopa.com/resources/industrial-building-types/): Warehouse/distribution, light industrial, manufacturing, flex, cold storage, truck terminals, industrial outdoor storage, rail-served buildings, and what clear height, loading, power, slab, and fire protection specifications mean.
- [Chicago industrial real estate](https://rospopa.com/resources/chicago-industrial-real-estate/): Warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, and flex-space evaluation checklist.
- [Industrial property due diligence](https://rospopa.com/resources/industrial-due-diligence/): Environmental assessments (Phase I/II), property condition, title and survey, zoning and permits, utilities, and how findings translate into price, credits, escrows, or repairs.
- [Chicagoland industrial submarkets and logistics corridors](https://rospopa.com/resources/chicagoland-industrial-submarkets/): Geography of the region's industrial clusters, highways, tollways, airports, and intermodal terminals; no market statistics.
- [Chicagoland industrial real estate: nine Illinois counties](https://rospopa.com/resources/chicagoland-industrial-real-estate/): Distinct county research paths and official planning, zoning, parcel, and assessment sources for Cook, DeKalb, DuPage, Grundy, Kane, Kendall, Lake, McHenry, and Will counties in Illinois, USA.
- [Property taxes on Illinois industrial real estate](https://rospopa.com/resources/illinois-industrial-property-taxes/): Assessment, equalization, levies, bills, appeals, Cook County incentive classifications, enterprise zones and TIF, and taxes in underwriting and leases.
- [Selling an industrial property](https://rospopa.com/resources/selling-industrial-property/): Common buyer types for 10,000–100,000 SF buildings, how buyers underwrite, what drives value, the document checklist, pricing approach, and the sale process.
- [Chicago commercial real estate research](https://rospopa.com/resources/chicago-commercial-real-estate/): Property types, jurisdiction, zoning, tax, and building research.
- [Commercial leasing](https://rospopa.com/resources/commercial-leasing/): Occupancy costs, lease terms, and a tour checklist.
- [Commercial investment](https://rospopa.com/resources/commercial-investment/): Acquisition diligence, cash flow, and financing risks.
- [Industrial and investment glossary](https://rospopa.com/resources/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of building, lease, underwriting, and Illinois property-records terms, each with a stable anchor link.
- [Search](https://rospopa.com/search/): Client-side search across every guide section and glossary term (not indexed).

## Scope

The regional industrial hub covers these nine Illinois counties, not an exhaustive or official definition of Chicagoland. Indiana and Wisconsin are outside this guide. Lake County refers to Illinois, not Indiana. County records and municipal permitting authority must be checked separately.

## Full text and feeds

- [llms-full.txt](https://rospopa.com/llms-full.txt): The complete text of every public guide in Markdown, regenerated whenever the guides change.
- [feed.xml](https://rospopa.com/feed.xml): Atom feed of the guides with publication and update dates.
- [sitemap.xml](https://rospopa.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical page list with last-modified dates and the photograph on each page.
- The homepage also carries a daily-refreshed list of recent Chicago industrial real estate headlines from public news feeds; those headlines belong to their publishers and are not part of this library's content.

The guides include interactive calculators (cap rate and value, debt service coverage, occupancy cost over a lease term, 1031 exchange deadlines). They are illustrative arithmetic on user-entered figures, not market data or advice.

This file is an optional reading directory, not an indexing instruction or a guarantee of inclusion in AI systems. robots.txt and page-level indexing directives are separate.
